findings.quote: Ekonomihistorikern Gunborg Sandell riktar en invandning ... mot Rahmqvists forklaring
findings.note: PARTIALLY: the stem asks for an objection to the EXPLANATION, and only D offers a rival explanation (wealth as confound); A (catalogue criteria widened 1958) and C (survivorship of the ornate towers) are objections to the DATA, a category mismatch a domain-free reader can see. The discipline label 'ekonomihistorikern' further narrows to the two economically framed options (B, D). Blind lean: D. Not a form-alone decision (B remains a substantive economic objection and the B-vs-D choice needs the passage), so flag, not kill.

findings.quote: Uppgiften var densamma i alla sjutton tornen, medan formen skiftade av skal som materialet bara delvis reder ut.
findings.note: PARTIALLY: on a generic 'vilket pastaende overensstammer bast' stem, B is the only non-committal umbrella claim; C overreaches ('samtliga ... bostader eller utsiktsplatser') and A overreaches in its second clause ('det var dessa som avgjorde utformningen'). Two overreach eliminations plus the measured-summary heuristic give a real edge over chance without the passage. Held at flag, not kill: D is also hedged ('tycks framfor allt'), so B is not the sole qualified option, and this is the standard shape of authentic HP global items, which the gate calibration says must not be killed.

findings.quote: Att utgiften inte upphör utan landar hos besökarna i stället för hos kommunen.
findings.note: B is an extreme proposal rather than an objection ('bemannade toaletter i varje kvarter i innerstaden, öppna dygnet runt') and C answers a different question than the stem asks (it explains the cause of the closures instead of objecting to them). The remaining pair is settled by the essay-thesis shape of A, so materially better than chance blind.
